title: 这次又是哪来的信心？NaNa说美股(2026.09.23)

keyPoints.text: The 10-year US Treasury yield surged to 5.135%, reaching its highest level since July 2007, triggered by a stronger-than-expected preliminary S&P Global Composite PMI of 58.4 indicating economic overheating and sticky inflation.

The US Treasury's $70 billion 5-year auction saw weak demand, with the cut-off yield reaching 5.033%—the highest since 2006—and primary dealer absorption rising to 15.8%, reflecting investor demand for higher term premium.
Treasury Secretary Bessent announced buybacks of between $4 billion and $6 billion in long-term Treasuries, but the market viewed the sum as insufficient to stem bearish bond market sentiment.

Citi reports that bearish capital flows across major US indices are driven by active new short positions rather than long liquidations; all remaining Russell 2000 long positions are at a loss, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq show resilience due to short covering.

Michael Burry substantially increased short positions against Micron, NBIS, Palantir, and semiconductor ETF SOXX, citing potential price pressure on DRAM once supply recovers from current capacity shifts.

JPMorgan believes the transmission of interest rates has shifted such that the market's critical psychological pressure threshold may have moved up from 5.0% to the 5.5%–6.0% range, though some fund managers are already trimming equities for high-yielding government bonds.

Oil price downside is seen as limited due to sharp domestic political rifts in Iran between civil diplomats and the Revolutionary Guard, which stalls diplomatic solutions and maintains upward pressure on bond yields.
GameStop stock has advanced sharply driven by record insider buying from CEO Ryan Cohen and three other board members, attracting speculative followers waiting for corporate announcements.

Michael Burry initiated large short positions against Micron, NBIS, Palantir, and the semiconductor ETF SOXX, arguing that memory shortages are temporary capacity reallocation issues that will depress DRAM prices once standard supply recovers.

AI infrastructure shadow-banking and secondary physical infrastructure contractors (like STRL, LGN, and MOD) experienced steep valuation drawdowns of over 50% due to physical buildout bottlenecks such as grid capacity and permitting, leaving retail investors trapped at peaks.

Consumer discretionary and restaurant stocks like McDonald's have fallen into bear territory as persistent inflation and cost of living curb customer traffic, marking lower foot traffic as an industry new normal.

Following the release of stronger-than-expected PMI data, market odds of an October Federal Reserve interest rate hike jumped from 55% to 73%, with expectations heating up for three additional hikes before June next year, pushing the 2-year Treasury yield up to around 4.945%.

Major tech names like Nvidia, Google, and Amazon dragged down US equity markets amid broad declines across tech and consumer sectors, following steep drops in banking stocks that signaled market vulnerability ahead of bond market weakness.

IONQ announced the development and testing of what it calls the industry's first end-to-end real-time quantum error correction system, supporting commercial-scale fault-tolerant quantum computing, though its pre-market rally of nearly 11% faded due to broader market risk aversion and liquidity tightening.

Apollo Global Management restricted redemptions on its flagship private credit fund for the third consecutive quarter, maintaining a 5% redemption cap despite investors seeking three times that amount.

Apollo Global Management faces pressure across its AI financing operations, having capped redemptions on its flagship private credit fund at 5% for a third consecutive quarter despite investor demand at 15%, while its Atlas fund faces up to £860 million ($1.1 billion) in potential losses from a financial firm collapse earlier this year.

AI hardware stocks exhibit deep internal divergence: core irreplaceable compute beneficiaries like SanDisk, Intel, AMD, and LITE have rebounded toward or broken into new highs post-summer correction due to solid earnings and technical moats, whereas secondary physical infrastructure contractors lack pricing power and remain severely depressed.

Investors must be wary of Wall Street narratives, as stocks often peak and start falling well before operational growth turns into a downturn; adding to losing positions to dollar-cost average during such structural declines can lead to catastrophic losses.

Beyond buying AI stocks and occasionally Bitcoin concept stocks, there are virtually no viable individual stock opportunities left in the market, because both the economy and financial markets are currently supported entirely by AI.

calls.thesis: Loan and mortgage stocks like RKT should only be kept on a watchlist and not bought until market expectations shift from interest rate hikes to rate cuts, as entering prematurely would lead to a painful holding period.
conditions: Until market expectations shift from rate hikes to rate cuts
risks: High 30-year mortgage rates suppressing demand and mortgage refinancing activity
Entering before monetary easing expectations emerge causes extended drawdown
